description: Per-equation rest-preservation gate (u-momentum, D(ua)/dt=momentum_u_duo_g3+pgrad_l97_u_duo_g3) of the duo LMARS SWE. The full 6-rule system exceeds the 40 GB Slurm cgroup at build; this compiles only the u-momentum rule's RHS (the heaviest, carrying the Lin-Rood L97 four-corner pressure gradient). Rest tendency exactly 0.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator

blocked_upstream_bindings.rust: Rust does NOT complete this case in CI-tolerable time as of EarthSciAST 9a81afd8b (dev profile at opt-level 2, the run-rust.sh build): the momentum-side rules fall off the taped evaluator (RhsStats: duo_swe_dp already shows 24 fallback rules against 60 taped; its RHS costs 332 ms) and this case's per-RHS cost is >= minutes — the full pde-tests invocation was killed at 2400 s wall, and even rhs_bench (compile + 6 RHS evaluations) exceeded 1800 s. MEASURED 2026-08-28 on duo_swe_ua; duo_swe_va and the full duo_swe freestream system are strictly larger. The sibling duo_swe_dp case IS armed for Rust (49 s, passes; the shape fix in EarthSciAST 64cb58335 unblocked it). Re-arm when the Rust taped/vectorized evaluator covers the esm-spec 9.6.8 reduced-rank/contracted makearray region values the duo momentum rules lower to — the same construct EarthSciAST fd81e922f taught the Julia affine stencilizer.
blocked_upstream_bindings.python: The Python numpy interpreter evaluates the duo halo-extension makearray region values (esm-spec 9.6.8 reduced-rank strips with a (k,l) contraction) through its scalar per-cell path (_eval_arrayop_scalar/_reduce_over_gated): cProfile on duo_swe_dp shows 1.77M scalar index-gathers per RHS evaluation, 17.4 s per warm RHS call. This case's momentum-side RHS is a multiple of that, putting the [0,3600] integration at many hours. MEASURED 2026-08-28 against EarthSciAST 9a81afd8b. Re-arm when the numpy interpreter vectorizes these gathers — the same construct EarthSciAST fd81e922f taught the Julia affine stencilizer.
